dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters localized primarily in the anterior and mid-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between pigmented mottled regions and the primary grey baseline.
